consequence: Per the frozen preregistration the 80-run sizing diagnostic was NOT executed. No CS scope class (CS-SMALL / CS-MEDIUM / CS-SCHEDULING-ARCH / CS-NO-SIGNAL) is claimed.

disqualifying_findings.evidence: all cs_* items are #[cfg(feature="experimental-cold-start")]; no arm/disarm public API
disqualifying_findings.finding: No runtime switch — the ladder is compile-time only, so CS-BASELINE and CS-LADDER-ONLY would be two DIFFERENT BINARIES.

disqualifying_findings.evidence: sender.rs:1184 (ON branch) vs :1193 (OFF legacy branch); on_event_batch at :1276
disqualifying_findings.finding: Enabling it REROUTES the whole event pipeline: on_event -> on_event_batch (four-phase) instead of on_event_core + schedule_transmit, with early-return paths that skip pacer.refill()/clock advance under conditions the OFF build does not have.
It makes the sender SELF-GENERATE Timer::Pto fires (CsTimerKind::BootstrapPto), changing the ARQ loss-declaration and tail-probe FIRING SCHEDULE — a second axis.
Ladder probes consume the SAME token bucket as DATA (pacer.try_send), so the ladder cannot be evaluated independently of the pacing axis under test.

disqualifying_findings.evidence: grep CsProbe receiver.rs = 0 hits; udp_runner.rs = 11 hits; udp_runner.rs:1-4 module doc
disqualifying_findings.finding: There is NO echo responder on the product RECEIVE path — receiver.rs contains ZERO CsProbe references. The 0x19->0x1A echo exists only in udp_runner.rs, whose own module doc says 'BENCH-RUNNER ... URETIM-YOLUNA-BAGLI-DEGIL' (not connected to the production path). Modelling that echo in the FS-CAL harness would be exactly the forbidden fake harness probe, and without it srtt can never resolve via probe echo.

gate: A1 (blocking) — the ladder EXISTS as real product code but enabling it is NOT a single-axis change
harness_note: A CsProbe carry + peer-echo path WAS implemented in the harness before this verdict (feature `dr-cs-2-ladder`). It is left in place but is NOT FAITHFUL (it models a peer capability the product receiver does not implement) and was NOT used to produce any verdict. Do not use it for science.
what_would_unblock: A runtime arm/disarm switch so both arms share ONE binary.

Either an event-pipeline equivalence proof (ON-with-ladder-disarmed == OFF, byte-identical incl. pacer.refill/clock advance and Timer::Pto firing schedule), or decoupling BootstrapPto from the ladder.
